t2.title: Animals be kept in zoos for educational purposes
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should animals be kept in zoos for educational purposes?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Do You Really Need Unlimited Data?

Mobile providers constantly push unlimited data plans as essential. But are they actually necessary for everyone? Let me share my thoughts.

Firstly, for heavy users who stream videos, work remotely, or use data-intensive apps, unlimited plans are undoubtedly valuable. The peace of mind of never worrying about overage charges is worth the extra cost.

However, many people consistently overestimate their data needs. If you're primarily connected to WiFi at home and work, a smaller plan might be more cost-effective.

Moreover, unlimited plans often come with hidden restrictions – speed throttling after certain limits or deprioritization during peak times.

Personally, I recommend tracking your actual data consumption for a few months before committing. You might be surprised how little you actually use!

What about you? Do you find unlimited data essential or overrated?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi ConnectPlus,


Phone good. Signal good. App ok. More games?


Bye
t2.sampleA2:
Hello ConnectPlus,

I like the phone. The signal is good in my house and in the city. The app is easy to use but it is slow sometimes. I want more data because I watch videos. Thank you.

Best,

Jasur Ergashev
t2.sampleB1:
Dear ConnectPlus,

I'm writing to give you some feedback on my new service. Overall, I'm quite happy with the switch. The network coverage has been pretty good in my area, both in the city and in the countryside. The app is mostly easy to use, although I had some trouble at first finding the settings menu.

One thing that would make my experience better is if you offered a loyalty program for long-term customers. Also, it would be helpful if the app showed more detailed information about my data usage. I think the prices are competitive, but it's important to keep offering good deals.

Sincerely,
Jasur Ergashev
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is such an interesting question, and honestly I can see both sides of it. On one hand, I do think zoos have real educational value. For a lot of kids, seeing a lion or an elephant up close is something they'll never forget, and it can spark a genuine interest in wildlife. Good zoos also run breeding programmes that help protect endangered species and raise awareness about the threats animals face in the wild. You simply can't get that from a textbook or a screen. On the other hand, I can't ignore the downsides. Keeping large animals in enclosures, however well designed, is never quite the same as their natural habitat. Some clearly struggle with the stress of captivity, and that's hard to justify in the name of education. Personally, I think the answer lies somewhere in the middle. Zoos can be a force for good, but only if animal welfare comes first and the focus is genuinely on conservation, not entertainment. What does everyone else think? Have you had a good or bad experience at a zoo? I'd love to hear your views! Dilnoza Karimova
t2.uzSample:
Sizga Haqiqatan Ham Cheksiz Internet Kerakmi?

Mobil aloqa provayderlari doimiy ravishda cheksiz internet rejalarni muhim deb targ'ib qilishadi. Lekin ular haqiqatan ham hamma uchun zarurmi? Keling, o'z fikrlarim bilan bo'lishay.

Birinchidan, video oqimini uzatuvchi, masofadan turib ishlaydigan yoki ko'p internet talab qiladigan ilovalardan foydalanadigan faol foydalanuvchilar uchun cheksiz rejalar, shubhasiz, qimmatlidir. Qo'shimcha to'lovlar haqida hech qachon tashvishlanmaslik xotirjamligi qo'shimcha xarajatga arziydi.

Biroq, ko'p odamlar doimiy ravishda internetga bo'lgan ehtiyojlarini haddan tashqari baholaydilar. Agar siz asosan uyda va ishda WiFi-ga ulangan bo'lsangiz, unda kichikroq reja tejamkorroq bo'lishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, cheksiz rejalar ko'pincha yashirin cheklovlar bilan birga keladi – ma'lum limitlardan keyin tezlikni cheklash yoki eng yuqori vaqtda ustuvorlikni pasaytirish.

Shaxsan men, biror rejaga qo'shilishdan oldin bir necha oy davomida internet sarfini kuzatib borishni tavsiya qilaman. Siz aslida qanchalik kam ishlatishingizdan hayron bo'lishingiz mumkin!

Sizchi? Siz cheksiz internetni muhim deb bilasizmi yoki ortiqcha baholangan deb?
t2.uzSampleA1:

t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom ConnectPlus,

Menga telefon yoqdi. Signali uyimda ham, shaharda ham yaxshi. Ilova ishlatishga oson, lekin ba'zida sekin ishlaydi. Videolarni ko'rganim uchun menga ko'proq ma'lumot kerak. Rahmat.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,

Jasur Ergashev
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli ConnectPlus,

Men sizga yangi xizmatim haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, men o'zgarishdan juda mamnunman. Tarmoq qamrovi mening hududimda, ham shaharda, ham qishloqda juda yaxshi bo'ldi. Ilova asosan ishlatish uchun qulay, garchi dastlab sozlamalar menyusini topishda biroz muammoga duch kelgan bo'lsam ham.

Mening tajribamni yanada yaxshilaydigan bir narsa, agar siz uzoq muddatli mijozlar uchun sodiqlik dasturini taklif qilsangiz bo'lardi. Shuningdek, agar ilova mening ma'lumotlarimdan foydalanishim haqida batafsilroq ma'lumot ko'rsatsa, foydali bo'lardi. Menimcha, narxlar raqobatbardosh, ammo yaxshi takliflarni taqdim etishni davom ettirish muhim.

Hurmat bilan,
Jasur Ergashev
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli ConnectPlus mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish bo'limi,

Men yaqinda ConnectPlus Mobile-ga o'tganimdan so'ng fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Umuman olganda, o'tishdan mamnunman, garchi menimcha yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud.

Tarmoq qamrovi shaharlarda ham, shahar atroflarida ham doimiy ravishda ishonchli bo'lib kelgan, bu mening oldingi provayderimga nisbatan sezilarli yaxshilanishdir. Mobil ilova odatda intuitiv; ammo, ma'lumotlarni monitoring qilish va billing ma'lumotlari kabi tez-tez ishlatiladigan funktsiyalarga tezroq kirish uchun navigatsiyani soddalashtirish mumkin.

Yaxshilash nuqtai nazaridan, men ma'lumotlar ogohlantirishlarini yanada batafsil sozlash imkoniyatini qadrlagan bo'lardim. Misol uchun, ma'lumotlar limitimning 50%, 75% va 90% da bildirishnomalar olish foydali bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, ilovaga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tezlikni tekshirishni integratsiya qilish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi. Nihoyat, yangi mijozlarni tavsiya qilganlik uchun rag'batlantirish taklif qilishni ko'rib chiqing. Menimcha, bu o'zgarishlar foydalanuvchi tajribasini yanada yaxshilaydi va mijozlarning sodiqligini oshiradi.

Hurmat bilan,
Jasur Ergashev

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the mobile provider. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear ConnectPlus Customer Care,

Thank you for reaching out. I am generally satisfied with my new service.

Firstly, the network coverage in my area is excellent. I rarely experience dropped calls or slow data speeds.

However, I have encountered some issues. The mobile app occasionally crashes when I try to check my usage. This should be addressed in future updates.

Additionally, I would appreciate more flexible payment options. Monthly automatic billing is convenient, but weekly payment options would suit some customers better.

Furthermore, offering family plans with shared data would be highly beneficial.

Thank you for your commitment to customer satisfaction.

Yours faithfully,
A New Customer
t12.sampleA1:
Hi ConnectPlus,
I like the phone.
Network good.
App OK.
More games?
Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hello ConnectPlus,
Thank you for the message. The network is good in my house and at work. But the app is not very good because it is slow. I want the app to be faster. And I want cheaper calls because they are expensive. Thank you.
Bye,
t12.sampleB1:
Dear ConnectPlus Customer Care,

Thank you for your email. I am writing to you about my experience with your service so far. The network coverage is mostly good in my town, but sometimes it's bad when I travel to the countryside. The app is okay, but I think it could be better. It's not very easy to use.

I think you should add some new features. For example, it would be good to have more data for the same price. Also, maybe you could offer discounts for students. I hope you can improve your service.

Sincerely,
A Customer
t12.sampleB2: Dear ConnectPlus Customer Care, Thank you for your warm welcome and for taking the time to ask about my experience so far. On the whole, I have been pleasantly surprised since making the switch. The network coverage in my area has been rock solid, with a strong signal both at home and around the city centre. Your app is also refreshingly straightforward, which made setting up my account a breeze. That said, there is still some room for improvement. I would love to see more detailed usage alerts so that I can keep an eye on my monthly allowance. A loyalty scheme that rewards long-term customers would also go a long way. All in all, I am very happy with the service and look forward to seeing how it develops. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev

Undan foydalanish unchalik oson emas.

Menimcha, siz ba'zi yangi funksiyalarni qo'shishingiz kerak. Masalan, bir xil narxga ko'proq ma'lumotga ega bo'lish yaxshi bo'lardi. Shuningdek, talabalar uchun chegirmalar taklif qilishingiz mumkin. Umid qilamanki, siz o'z xizmatingizni yaxshilaysiz.

Sizning elektron pochtangiz va xizmatingizdan foydalanish tajribamga qiziqishingiz uchun tashakkur. Umuman olganda, men xizmatdan qoniqdim, lekin men ko'tarmoqchi bo'lgan bir nechta nuqtalar bor.

Birinchidan, tarmoq qamrovi odatda shahar ichida ishonchli bo'ldi. Biroq, men ba'zi shahar atrofi hududlarida signal kuchining nomuvofiqligini sezdim, bu biroz umidsizlikka sabab bo'ladi. Ikkinchidan, ilova funksional bo'lsa-da, uning foydalanuvchi interfeysi biroz eskirgan va yanada intuitiv dizayndan foyda ko'rishi mumkin. Men asosiy ma'lumotlarni topish uchun bir nechta menyu orqali o'tishimga to'g'ri keladi.

Qo'shimcha funksiyalarga kelsak, menimcha, yanada kuchli spam qo'ng'iroqlarini filtrlash tizimi juda qimmatli bo'ladi. Shuningdek, ma'lumotlardan foydalanish bo'yicha ogohlantirishlarni sozlash imkoniyati oylik limitimni yanada samarali boshqarish uchun foydali bo'ladi. Nihoyat, uzoq muddatli mijozlar uchun sodiqlik mukofotlarini taklif qilishni o'ylab ko'ring. Mijozlarning fikr-mulohazalariga e'tiboringiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
ConnectPlus mijozi
